about.subtitle: About me
about.title: Software engineering, from school projects to a product team
about.text:
I am a fourth-year Software Engineering student at the Faculty of Natural Sciences and Mathematics in Kragujevac, specializing in software development. My journey in programming began during high school, where I developed a strong foundation in languages like Python, Java, C++, and web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Over time, I have nurtured a passion for building efficient, scalable, and user-friendly solutions.

I am particularly interested in full-stack development and software engineering, with a growing curiosity about cybersecurity and innovative IT solutions. My projects often reflect a commitment to problem-solving, teamwork, and continuous learning.

Beyond coding, I enjoy table tennis and exploring new advancements in the tech industry. I am fluent in English and always open to collaborating on meaningful projects that challenge me to grow.

items.summary: During a summer internship at Inovatec Systems I worked on the team building the AI Assisted Candidate Intelligence Platform. I used Angular on the frontend and .NET 8 on the backend, with MS SQL Server for data, plus Azure and Docker, in an agile setup run through Jira.
One-month internship covering security operations and cyber operations.
